thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 4 - GPU pool 'us-west-2-gpu-pool-3' reporting sustained saturation and request queue growth. Alerts: autoscaler_max_reached, request_queue_length > 1200, p99 latency spike. PagerDuty: paged oncall. Monitoring: https://monitoring.redwood.example/incident/5223456789

alice: acknowledging, I'm on it. seeing lots of 429 throttles and queued requests in the frontend. major increase starting ~12:05 UTC. taking channel.

dave: oncall SRE here. autoscaler logs show nodes failed to provision - hit regional GPU quota and vendor-side delay. errors: 
```
EKS-Autoscaler: failed to launch instance: QuotaExceeded: Insufficient capacity for GPU instances in us-west-2
attempts=5 backoff=30s
```

carla: ML eng — this started right after the v34 model rollout (canary -> 20% traffic) which increased default context window and kv-cache prefetch. early telemetry shows per-request KV cache footprint ~2.3x. suspect memory/throughput regression.

bob: infra — confirmed, new variant has larger KV prefetch causing more GPU memory usage and longer per-request runtimes which reduces concurrency. autoscaler retried but we hit our soft quota. manual scale attempts are throttled by provider. I'm reaching out to cloud support, but not immediate.

erin: product — do we have customer impact numbers? which customers seeing errors? any SLAs at risk?

alice: quick impact snapshot (rolling 15m): 
- overall request success rate down from 99.8% -> 98.4%
- 429 throttles increased from ~0.2% -> 9.7% of requests
- p95 latency up 3x, p99 up 6x
- top affected customer: AcmeCorp (10% of errors), BetaApps (6%), internal QA project high error rate

dave: adding logs showing queue growth and throttle messages from router: 
```
router: enqueue_request id=0x7f3 len_queue=1234 route=redwood/v34
router: throttle_request id=0x7f4 reason=pool_exhausted
```

carla: immediate suggestion: pause v34 rollout and fail traffic back to v33 shim. v33 uses smaller context prefetch and fits current capacity. can we rollback or route?

bob: we can route traffic via router feature-flag to v33 for all traffic for now. will need a quick deploy to update routing table. preference: route 100% of v34 -> v33 to stop growth.

alice: mitigation plan (immediate):
1) Pause v34 rollout (carla) -> REQ: deploy new routing config to divert traffic.
2) Apply emergency throttle policy to non-paid/platinum tiers to reduce load by ~20% (dave)
3) Reduce batching and prefetch on v34 model config (carla) — but don't roll this until after revert to avoid churn.
4) Open support ticket for GPU quota bump and concurrently try warm pools in another region as fallback (bob)

DeployBot: Deployment action: route-update v34->v33 flag applied to canary. initiating rollout of routing change to 100%. CI: green.

bob: I pushed the routing change. verifying hit counts now.

alice: traffic switched. monitoring now: queue length dropping from 1250 -> 420 over 4 minutes. p99 latency trending down. good sign.

carla: confirming v33 is stable under load. kv footprint back to expected baseline. I will hold v34 and open a patch to reduce kv prefetch and context window before we reattempt.

dave: applied throttles: non-enterprise traffic reduced token_budget to 0.8x and raised per-route short-circuit to protect pools. logs show error rate dropping.

erin: customer-facing: we need a short note for affected customers. alice, can you confirm impact window and mitigation steps? I'll draft communication after you confirm facts.

alice: impact window: 12:05 UTC - 12:18 UTC (mitigated by routing change). estimated ~13k requests affected, ~0.5% of total monthly requests in that window. primary cause: v34 rollout increasing per-request GPU footprint (KV prefetch/context expansion) causing autoscaler to hit max and vendor quota to block scale.

dave: oncall handoff incoming — I'm taking hand for the next hour to monitor warm pools, escalation as needed: alice -> dave handoff at 12:22 UTC. @carla please coordinate on the v34 patch.

carla: ack. opening PR with two immediate controls: 
- config: kv_prefetch_limit = 0.6
- config: max_context_tokens = 2048
I'll also add telemetry counters for per-request gpu_mem_estimate.

bob: cloud support answered — quota bump is possible but ETA 3-4 hours. vendor can hot-add capacity in diff region faster; I'll prepare cross-region routing if needed.

erin: ok I drafted a brief customer message: 
"We've identified and mitigated an availability issue affecting a subset of requests caused by a model rollout. Traffic has been reverted to the previous model and we're investigating a targeted fix. No data loss. Follow-up postmortem forthcoming."

alice: nice. please include expected timeline for permanent fix (48h) and that we paused the rollout.

DeployBot: Action: rollout-v34 pause confirmed.

dave: monitoring update at 12:30 UTC: queues stabilized, 429s dropped to baseline. will keep 15-min cadence checks for next 2 hours.

erin: schedule: postmortem P0 for tomorrow 09:00 UTC. stakeholders: eng-runtime, eng-ml, infra, product.

alice: final notes for thread: root cause (probable): v34 increased KV prefetch/context causing per-request GPU memory/time to increase -> reduced concurrency -> autoscaler tried to scale -> provider quota prevented sufficient scale -> queue growth and throttling. near-term mitigation: route back to v33, throttle non-paid traffic, patch v34 to lower kv/context. long-term: add rollout safety checks on per-request gpu_estimate and deploy automated rollback triggers when pool saturation metrics exceed threshold.

carla: I'll own the v34 patch and testing. bob please escalate quota if needed. dave will monitor. erin will send customer comms.

alice: incident declared mitigated at 12:34 UTC. oncall: dave (12:22-13:22). opening postmortem ticket: PM-3421.

IncidentBot: Incident 4 status -> MITIGATED (12:34 UTC). Follow-up: postmortem requested.

alice: thanks everyone. we'll meet in the postmortem to walk through telemetry and add rollout gates. :thumbsup:
